Re-ran the instruction budget gate at the merge result to confirm, then regenerated the mirror with generate_skills.py rather than hand editing it.

workLog.action: Found the real cause of the red security job
workLog.detail: CVE-2026-69247 in cryptography 49.0.0, fixed in 50.0.0. The pip-audit line naming ai-agents 0.1.0 is a skip-reason table, not the failure; pip-audit only treats a skipped dependency as fatal under --strict, which the step does not pass. An issue with the wrong root cause was drafted and held rather than filed.

workLog.action: Root caused why the resolver could not reach the fix
workLog.detail: exclude-newer = 7 days under [tool.uv] pinned the lock to the vulnerable release. uv lock --upgrade-package cryptography was a silent no-op with a zero-line diff. Added cryptography = false to the existing [tool.uv.exclude-newer-package] table, then verified with a negative control: 49.0.0 reproduces CVE-2026-69247 and exits 1, 50.0.0 reports no known vulnerabilities and exits 0.

workLog.action: Removed a change of mine that did nothing
workLog.detail: An entry added to the _ALLOWED_BEHIND_GUARD frozenset was already present, so the addition was a semantic no-op that only ruff could see, as B033. Negative control: 51 tests pass with the addition removed, which proves the workflow file carried the real fix. A membership insertion is idempotent, so no behavioral test can distinguish a redundant one from a necessary one.

workLog.action: Wrote the retrospective for the sweep
workLog.detail: .agents/retrospective/2026-08-04-twenty-nine-green-prs-merged-into-a-red-main.md, classified against FAILURE-MODES classes 5 and 4. Confirmed mechanically that no merge queue exists: none of the 62 workflow files carries a merge_group trigger.
